summary: Iteration 23 — OG share image for Share-my-Patch. Verified backend OG endpoints + HTML preview wrapper + cache invalidation on edit, and frontend share modal URL switch + SPA og:image meta injection + /api/share/preview→/p redirect. All 13 baseline tests pass, 2 new iter-23 tests pass (15/15 backend), and all 5 frontend assertions pass.

minor.issue: og:image ?v= cache-buster token is updated_at[:14] (YYYYMMDDTHHMMS) → ~10-second resolution. Two snapshot edits within the same 10-second window produce the same ?v= even though the underlying og.png bytes do change. Social caches keyed on the URL won't refetch in that window. Bytes-level cache invalidation works correctly (verified).

action_items: Optional: widen the preview HTML ?v= cache-buster precision from updated_at[:14] to at least [:15] (includes the seconds units digit) — or drop the slice entirely and use the full ISO timestamp URL-encoded — so two quick successive edits both bust social-cache CDN. The og.png cache itself uses the full updated_at, so only the URL-side token is affected.
critical_code_review_comments: share.py _render_preview_html duplicates the HTML/JS escape concerns — html.escape is used for attributes but the og:image URL is not URL-encoded. As long as updated_at stays alphanumeric this is safe, but worth noting if future versions of the token include reserved chars.

share_og.py uses ImageDraw private `_image` attr to paste rotated leaves (`draw._image`). Works today on Pillow ≥10, but accessing _underscored attrs may break on future Pillow majors. Consider keeping a reference to the Image object explicitly.
share.py module-scoped _PROFANITY list duplicated with patrons.py — small DRY opportunity for a shared sanitiser util.

share.py /share/patch/{id}/og.png Cache-Control is 1 day, but the cache-key version uses updated_at. CDN/social caches won't see the new URL until ?v= bumps in the preview HTML — see the [:14] bug above. Worth lifting `og.png?v=…` from the preview wrapper into the SPA's og:image too (SharedPatch.jsx currently appends no ?v= cache-buster on the JS-injected meta).
seed_data_creation: Test snapshots are auto-cleaned via fixtures (test_share_patch.py) and the iter23 tests delete their own snapshots in `finally`. The frontend e2e flow created one snapshot and deleted it via the modal's delete button (data-testid='share-patch-delete-confirm').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_share_patch.py (13) + /app/backend/tests/test_share_og_iter23.py (2). All green. Frontend Share modal correctly uses /api/share/preview/{id} for the copyable URL and /p/{id} for the Open Preview link; SharedPatch.jsx injects og:image/width/height + twitter:card via useEffect; the FastAPI preview HTML wrapper redirects humans to /p/{id} via window.location.replace + meta-refresh. The only nit is the ?v= cache-buster token resolution (10s) — see action_items.
rca of the issue: n/a — no functional bug, only the cache-buster precision nit documented above.
